headline: NTSC-U frontend routines land in an occasional development day
summary: #1 brings native NTSC-U frontend routines into the decompilation, covering state setters, timers, fades and dialog handling. This gives contributors more original behaviour represented in C, rather than a new playable feature. The progress commit reports NTSC-U at 5,677 of 16,222 functions and 8.38% matched code; matching means compiling to the original bytes.
highlights: The snapshot's separate progress object records 5,807 of 16,164 functions and 657,780 of 7,546,948 code bytes (8.72%), without a release label; it differs from the explicitly NTSC-U commit figure.
